label: POST-HOC ablation (not pre-registered): image budget and tiling on the 43 pilot forms. It chooses the setting of arm B of the confirmation (Amendment 4.1), committed before any read of the 100. Accepted-field errors are judged against the pilot truth (adjudicated where available, else PREP).

baseline.says: page + 6 tiles, default budget (280 soft tokens/image)

page_1120.says: page only (native resolution, no tiles) at 1,120 soft tokens

page_560.says: page only (no tiles) at 560 soft tokens

recommendation.why: no arm accepts more forms without more accepted-field errors than the baseline

note: The AMD Token Factory runs Gemma at a fixed image budget, so the 300's numbers and the public live read use that budget; the higher budget was planned for a self-hosted MI300X (dry run only, results/dryrun/), never measured.
